turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on am, is and are?
turns.tutor:
Hi! Of course. Just to refresh: am with I, is with he/she/it and singular nouns, are with you/we/they and plural nouns, and the verb is never left out in English.

First exercise. Write am, is or are: My father ___ a pilot. (Answer with only the missing word.)
